nodes.summary: For a natural number $\ell$, $a_{3,\ell}$ is the sum over the integers $1 \le i \le \lfloor (\ell - 1)/2 \rfloor$ of $\binom{\ell}{2i+1} q_i$, where $q_i$ is the integer part of $4\,(2i+1)!/((i-1)!\,(i+3)!)$.
nodes.title: The exponent $a_{3,\ell}$

nodes.summary: For every number field $K$, $a_K(1) = 1$, where $a_K(n)$ is the number of ideals of the ring of integers of $K$ of absolute norm $n$: the unit ideal is the only ideal of norm $1$.
nodes.title: The Dedekind zeta coefficient at $1$

nodes.summary: For a number field $K$ with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$ and a natural number $n$, $a_K(n)$ is the number of ideals of $\mathcal{O}_K$ of absolute norm $n$. These are the coefficients of $\zeta_K(s) = \sum_{n \ge 1} a_K(n)\, n^{-s}$.
nodes.title: Coefficients of the Dedekind zeta function

nodes.summary: Let $\chi$ be a nontrivial Dirichlet character modulo $4$ and let $\varepsilon > 0$. Then there is a real constant $C$ such that for every real $T \ge 1$, $\int_1^T |L(1/2 + it, \chi)|^4 \, dt \le C\, T^{1 + \varepsilon}$.
nodes.title: Fourth moment of the $L$-function modulo $4$
